correctness.rationale: The final recurrence B_1=101, B_{i+1}=B_i B_i[i+1..|B_i|], and length 2^{i-1}+i+1 fix all normalization conventions. For a fixed length-m cylinder, whole-factor counts satisfy N_{i+1}=2N_i-D_i+J_i with 0<=D_i<=i and 0<=J_i<=m-1; summing scaled errors proves N_i=2^{i-1}mu+O(i+m). Comparing arbitrary prefixes to a shorter initial index (contracting by <=3/4) bounds the accumulated discrepancy by O_u((1+log N)^2). A factor occurring arbitrarily late has doubling descendants until its starting index p, overwhelming the eventual loss budget p+1; this proves strict positive frequency for every allowed factor, with forbidden 00 absent. To prove h_mu=0 the recursion embeds B_I as a subsequence of B_j^{2^{I-j}}, deleting 2^{I-j}(j+1)-I-1 symbols; at most m times this count damages length-m windows. Thus H_m<=1+log_2|B_j|+m min(1,m(j+1)/2^{j-1}); m=2^{floor(j/2)} makes H_m/m tend to zero. Subadditivity makes the full entropy rate zero. Recurrent/full-language input from Shallit is explicitly assumed; not derived from computer checks. Independent finite reconstruction through level16 agrees with length, no-00 and factor-frequency behavior, not an infinite proof.
residual_risks: The proof uses Shallit's established recurrence and full factor-language theorems; no claim of ergodicity, uniqueness or uniform recurrence. O_u constant depends on the fixed word. Finite level16 check is only corroboration.
